jinan-2020.notes: Source 1: the XCPCIO header prints the start as 2020-12-26 21:00:00 CST and the end as 2020-12-27 02:00:00 CST (the pack says 2020-12-27); contest_date left null because the two printed days differ. Only 32 of the board's team rows are filled in our copy (513 empty rows follow): a capture of the full board would be needed for team counts. Source 6 names C 'Stone Merge' and G 'Xor Transform' where the pack has 'Stone Game' and 'Xor Transformation'.
